authority: SQLite is the controlled migration source for legacy application records; protected Saved Data resource files are the target production authority while authentication remains protected SQLite

rules.cutoverRule: Deletion-only compatibility state. It is not user content and must not become permanent Saved Data.

For a signed-in user, Users/{paddedUserId}/voice.json is authoritative, including an empty resource which resolves to account defaults. The browser key remains only guest/file-mode preference state and must never be automatically promoted into an authenticated account or used as authenticated save fallback.

This browser save remains guest/local game progress only. Signed-in Recreation sessions use the authoritative account game resource and ignore the browser copy. Never offer, merge or promote this browser save into an authenticated account.

This browser save remains guest/local game progress only. Signed-in Recreation sessions use the authoritative account game resource and ignore the browser copy. Never offer, merge or promote this browser save into an authenticated account.
This controls device-specific automatic round progression and is not account progression.

The aggregate browser profiles remain guest/local progress only. Signed-in Recreation sessions use account game resources and ignore this browser aggregate. Never split, offer or promote it into authenticated account progress.

Retired metadata from the former Recreation browser-import flow. It contains no game progress and is deleted when authenticated account authority is established; it must never bind or enable import candidates.

This browser save remains guest/local game progress only. Signed-in Recreation sessions use the authoritative account game resource and ignore the browser copy. Never offer, merge or promote this browser save into an authenticated account.
Recipe titles are regenerated from page content and are not the favourites authority.

For a signed-in user, account profile state is authoritative, including an empty profile. Any pre-existing browser profile is retired before account load; compatibility storage may then be rebuilt from accepted server state only. Never offer or promote the browser copy into the account.
Generic wrapper calls are accounted for by the concrete keys passed into them.

This browser save remains guest/local game progress only. Signed-in Recreation sessions use the authoritative account game resource and ignore the browser copy. Never offer, merge or promote this browser save into an authenticated account.

For a signed-in user, the account routine is authoritative, including an empty routine. Physical account-named browser copies are retired and compatibility reads are virtualised from server state. Signed-out local behaviour remains local. Never offer or promote a browser routine into the account.

For a signed-in user, account groups and assignments are authoritative, including an empty section. Physical account-named browser copies are retired and compatibility reads are virtualised from server state. Signed-out local behaviour remains local. Never offer or promote browser groups into the account.

Skincare recipe slider settings are server-only in Users/{paddedUserId}/skincare.json#sliders. The recipe runtime must not read or write browser slider state and signed-out users have no persistent slider save. Any historical __baseline_slider_state__ browser copies are deletion-only legacy data and must never be merged, promoted or used as a save fallback.
These are recovery copies created only on divergence or revision conflict. Never auto-import, retry or delete them until the authoritative resource has been reviewed.
The current start-day/display preference affects calendar presentation rather than persistent routine content and remains device-local.

For a signed-in user, account active-workout state is authoritative, including no active workout. Any pre-existing browser workout is retired before account load; compatibility storage may then be rebuilt only from accepted server state. Never import or promote a browser workout.
These known bridge lookup keys are already covered by the separate Fitness cache and file-protocol fallback decisions. They create no additional browser resource.

Retired recovery keys from the former Fitness explicit-import flow. New runtime code does not create or import them; authenticated startup removes any remaining copies. Revision conflicts continue to block unsafe writes rather than restoring browser authority.
The server plan is authoritative during migration; this cache may only accelerate display and must be replaced after a verified authoritative read.
Production uses the protected Fitness API. This fallback must not compete with SQLite during migration or the Saved Data resource after cutover.

This Tactical Operations browser save remains signed-out guest/local progress only. When signed in, the Baseline Realm tacticalOperations account section is authoritative even when absent or empty, and the browser save is ignored. Never offer, merge or promote it into authenticated account state.

This Tactical Operations browser save remains signed-out guest/local progress only. When signed in, the Baseline Realm tacticalOperations account section is authoritative even when absent or empty, and the browser save is ignored. Never offer, merge or promote it into authenticated account state.

Retired metadata from the former Tactical Operations browser-import flow. It contains no Tactical Operations progress and is deleted on signed-in account load; it must never bind or enable an import candidate.
Legacy Games Hub tab/view preference only. Baseline Recreation now uses canonical URL state; startup removes this obsolete local/session key and it must never become Saved Data.
Do not persist as account data.
Never migrate browser-stored password material or treat this preview fallback as an account source.
Authenticated server sessions remain authoritative; do not migrate this local preview session.
This temporary route handoff exists only while replacing a standalone recipe shell with the complete parent application. Never migrate it to Saved Data.
This remembers only the selected My Body subtab for the current browser session and is not Fitness account data.

These values remember only My Routine navigation, one-load disclosure, summary filter or public calendar/view presentation for the current browser session. They are UI state, not routine content or account data, and must never become Saved Data resources.
This remembers only that microphone access was approved for the current browser session. It is not Voice account settings and must never be migrated to Saved Data.
This is a one-session permission to start a scheduled workout early. It is not workout history or plan data and expires with the browser session.

These keys choose which already-server-owned Fitness plan is shown or carry the one-device create-plan handoff. They contain no plan body and must never be treated as plan persistence or uploaded as account data.

The Fitness Routine server resource is authoritative, including an empty routine. Authenticated browser routine copies are retired before authoritative GET handling and may never be imported or promoted. Existing workspace compatibility must not become fallback persistence after a failed or conflicted server save.
Retired quarantine key from the former Fitness Routine explicit-import flow. New runtime code neither creates nor imports it; authenticated startup removes any remaining copy.

For a signed-in user, account progressionHistory is authoritative, including an empty section. Pre-existing browser outcomes/failures are retired before account load and compatibility storage is rebuilt only from accepted server state. Never import or promote browser history.
